question: In 1928, which equation was derived and combines quantum theory and special relativity to describe the behaviour of an electron moving at a relativistic speed?
solution:
The correct answer is the__** Dirac Equation**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **1928, Paul Dirac **introduced his equation, now known as **Dirac’s equation.**
 
• His goal was to create a** single equation **that would be valid for **all speeds, from slow to relativistic**.
 
• Dirac realized that to achieve this, he needed to incorporate **special relativity **principles into the existing quantum framework.
 
• Dirac’s equation is a** first-order partial differential equation** that describes the behavior of an electron.
 
• The Dirac’s equation predicts the existence of antimatter (positrons), which was later confirmed experimentally.
 
• It explains the fine structure of the hydrogen spectrum.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 **__Bernoulli’s Equation:__**

__
 
• **Bernoulli’s equation** is a fundamental principle in** fluid dynamics.**
 
• It describes the** conservation of energy for an ideal fluid **(incompressible and non-viscous) flowing along a streamline.
 
• It **relates the pressure, velocity, and gravitational potential energy** of the fluid.

**Lorentz Equation:**__

__
 
• The** Lorentz equation **is used in** electromagnetism** and describes how electric and magnetic fields transform under Lorentz transformations (special relativity).
 
• It is crucial for understanding the behavior of **charged particles** in electromagnetic fields.

**Helmholtz Equation:**__

 
• The **Helmholtz equation** appears in various fields, including electromagnetics, acoustics, and heat conduction.
 
• It describes the behavior of **harmonic waves **(e.g., sound waves, electromagnetic waves) in a medium.
